[S]C/S AC IS GOING IN AND OUT WITH THE COLDNESS OF IT..CHECK AND ADVISE Was able to verify concern of A/C not blowing cold due to no air blowing at all. I started by bench testing the blower motor and it did work. I then ensured I was getting power to it and I was gettnig 12.3V. I then tested pin 1 and 2 for voltage and did not get any. I then hooked a jumper from the ground pin to the blower motor, to a chassis ground and the blower immediately started running. I then removed pieces of the dash to see ground GM06 and it was secure. I then tested resistance from pin 2 of the blower motor to pin two of the control module and I got .7Ohms which is good. i did the same from pin 4 of the control module to ground and got .7Ohms, ruling out a wiring issue. Due to these testings, I recommend replacing the A/C blower motor control module due to an internal fault and testing again. Replaced the A/C blower motor control module and started the vehicle. Turned A/C on max and made sure the AC button was on. Now cold air blows as normal. No further repairs at this time
